title: Information retrieval foundations
content: Information retrieval finds relevant documents from a collection. An inverted index maps terms to document identifiers and token positions. Ranking models estimate document relevance.

title: BM25 ranking explained
content: BM25 is a probabilistic ranking function. It combines inverse document frequency with term frequency saturation and document length normalization. BM25 is useful for keyword search.

title: Building responsible web crawlers
content: A web crawler discovers links and extracts HTML content. Respect robots.txt, rate limits and site policies. Bound the frontier, deduplicate URLs and avoid crawling private networks.

title: Machine learning model evaluation
content: Precision and recall measure classification performance. Average precision summarizes the precision recall curve. Use a held out test set and avoid data leakage.

title: Vector search and retrieval augmented generation
content: Vector search compares dense embeddings using cosine similarity. Retrieval augmented generation grounds language model responses in retrieved evidence. Hybrid search combines lexical and vector retrieval.

title: Database indexes and query planning
content: Database indexes accelerate queries by reducing scans. B trees support ordered lookup. SQL query plans show access patterns and help optimize database performance.

title: Multi agent research systems
content: Multi agent research uses specialized planning, retrieval, analysis and verification stages. Evidence provenance, citation validation and bounded execution improve reliability.

title: Fraud detection in financial transactions
content: Fraud detection uses anomaly detection and supervised machine learning. Imbalanced datasets require careful threshold selection, precision recall analysis and explainable predictions.

title: Distributed systems and caching
content: Distributed systems coordinate services across networks. Caching reduces latency but creates consistency tradeoffs. Redis supports fast key value operations.

title: Python API design with FastAPI
content: FastAPI provides typed request validation, dependency injection and OpenAPI documentation. Separate application services from HTTP routes to support testing and maintainability.

title: Search engine phrase queries
content: Phrase queries require exact token order. Store positions in an inverted index to distinguish machine learning from learning machine. Autocomplete expands query prefixes.

title: Search ranking evaluation
content: Evaluate search using mean reciprocal rank, recall at k and normalized discounted cumulative gain. Use fixed relevance judgments and report latency alongside ranking quality.
